description: Frontend consumption catalog for the bounded Workspace LEGO. It renders declared Workspace identity and lifecycle only when handed over by the application; it never creates a workspace, calls a provider or implies execution authority.

publication.note: The frontend receives contract rows through the application seam. It does not read backend files or claim a publication that was not handed over.

rules: The frontend may display a Workspace record only when the application hands over that exact record.
An unknown or malformed Workspace record is refused by name and never widened into a generic project.
The UI does not redefine the backend lifecycle, limits, permissions or provider semantics.
A workspace kind is metadata, not evidence that filesystem, terminal, process or remote authority is available.
Workspace metadata is displayed as descriptive state; it never becomes an action or permission grant.
No Workspace metadata enters the browser boot payload merely because this catalog exists.
